title: Restricted Fourier Weight
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on $\\{−1,1\\}^n$, let $J\\subseteq[n]$, and let $S\\subseteq J$. The restricted Fourier weight at $S$ is the sum, over all subsets $T$ of the coordinates outside $J$, of the squares of the Fourier coefficients of $f$ indexed by the union of $S$ and $T$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
